blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `createOrderLineItems` method. This belongs to the Order Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).
This method creates a line item.

```ts
const lineItems = await orderModuleService.createOrderLineItems({
  title: "Shirt",
  quantity: 1,
  unit_price: 20
})
```
